knownLimitations: The native dependency source bundle is partial
Portal catalogue access does not establish playback of every channel
Large catalogues retain at most 30000 unique channels and 8 MB selected fields; a visible notice marks truncation
Short playback samples do not establish uninterrupted long-session playback
Provider-specific SN, pairing, session media headers and DRM may still prevent playback
